data.name: Kalinago Beach Resort
data.address: Morne Rouge Bay, Locally Known As BBC Beach, Saint Georgeʼs, Grenada
data.description:
Nestled in a lush, tranquil cove on Morne Rouge Beach, this relaxed resort is a 15-minute walk from Grand Anse Beach, 4 km from Grenada Golf & Country Club and 6 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport.
Down-to-earth rooms with handcrafted teak furnishings feature balconies or patios, as well as beach views, flat-screens and coffeemakers. Wi-Fi access is available. Room service is offered.
Regular cocktail socials, entertainment activities, golfing green fees and use of snorkeling gear are included. Other amenities consist of a warm restaurant/bar with sea views, plus an outdoor pool and 2 bars (1 swim-up). Minimum-stay rules may apply.
